baseline.reason: The stock build failed because UBSan instrumented SQLite's build-time lemon generator, which aborted before sqlite3 was produced. I therefore built each supplied worktree in a persistent cgsa-sqlite Docker container with 32-bit multilib support, generated sqlite3.c using unsanitized build tools, and compiled the identical /poc/poc.c with 32-bit ASan+UBSan for every version.
